decisions.statement: A status other than 404 matches nothing.
A body with no Anthropic error envelope matches nothing.
An envelope naming an error type other than `not_found_error` matches nothing.
A body carrying keys the envelope does not name still matches.
A match has the envelope message as the reason.
A match reading an envelope with no message has `not_found_error` as the reason.
A reason no account has marked decides mark-rebind.
A reason the current account marked first decides mark-rebind.
A reason another account marked first decides global-unmark naming that account.
The reason a classification carries is the key the marks are held under.
Nothing here writes to the map of marked reasons.
Nothing here sees a response beyond the status and the body.
An envelope message that is an empty string becomes an empty reason.
A mark held under an empty account name decides global-unmark.

definition: what a 404 body says about upstream not carrying the model asked for
